SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, p.P_CREATE_DATE AS P_CREATE_DATE, r.REC_END_DATE, r.REGION, r.PRODUCT_URL, q.QR_ID,
p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, p.PRODUCT_CONTENT, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_COUNT, p.READ_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_NO,
m.MEMBER_NO AS HOST_NO, m.MEMBER_NICK AS HOST_NAME, m.MEMBER_GRADE AS HOST_GRADE,
(SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS THUMBNAIL
FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN QR_AUTH q ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = q.RECRUITMENT_NO
WHERE r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS IN ('진행', '마감') AND p.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N'
ORDER BY p.P_CREATE_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT I.IMG_NO, I.IMG_PATH, I.IMG_RENAME, I.IMG_ORIGINAL, I.IMG_LEVEL, I.IMG_TYPE, I.IMG_TYPE_NO FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE = 'AD_BANNER' AND I.IMG_TYPE_NO = 1 ORDER BY I.IMG_LEVEL ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE, P.READ_COUNT, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, M.MEMBER_NICK, C.CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT PC.CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY PC WHERE C.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = PC.CATEGORY_NO) AS PARENT_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS THUMBNAIL FROM PRODUCT P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.AUTHORITY = 3 ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE, P.READ_COUNT, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, M.MEMBER_NICK, C.CATEGORY_NAME, ( SELECT PC.CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY PC WHERE C.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = PC.CATEGORY_NO ) AS PARENT_CATEGORY_NAME, ( SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) AS THUMBNAIL FROM PRODUCT P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.AUTHORITY = 3 ORDER BY P.READ_COUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY
